lede: A real NASA Artemis launch camera reel, compressed as SVX2, decoded by hand-tuned 65816 assembly, and animated at a verified 30 fps through Mode 7 in a genuine 32 KiB FastROM cartridge image.
keysHtml: Self-running — the ROM validates every embedded frame, then continuously plays the Artemis launch reel.
doc:
What this proves

The cartridge immediately animates a Mode 7 title while it performs real ROM-to-high-WRAM packet staging and validates every embedded 4,480-byte frame. After the title spins out, one SVX2 keyframe and in-place deltas play through an NMI-counted scheduler.

Cartridge-native dashboard

The SNES changes PPU modes at scanline 192: Mode 7 presents the video above, while a conventional Mode 1 BG3 tilemap renders TIME, measured FPS, and health state below. The dashboard is generated by the cartridge—not browser chrome and not pixels burned into the footage.

30 fps full-pipeline result

The post-title emulator regression charges packet DMA, assembly decode, dashboard updates, and presentation DMA. It records 397 presentations in 1,200 VBlanks, with zero CRC failures and zero deadline slips.

Source footage: NASA Artemis I press-site camera, November 16, 2022. Hit Verify fidelity to require the cartridge's two-loop target gate live in this tab.
